match.pattern: ^your\s+(?<issuer>[a-z][a-z ]{1,38}?)\s+credit card\s+[x*]{2,}[- ]?(?<mask>\d{2,4})\s+bill\s+of\s+(?:rs\.?|inr|₹)\s*(?<amt>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+has been successfully paid via kiwi\.?\s*$

examples.body: Your YES Bank Credit Card XXXX-9876 bill of Rs.1200 has been successfully paid via Kiwi.
Your YES Bank Credit Card XXXX-9876 bill of Rs.1200 could not be paid via Kiwi.

match.pattern: ^[^\r\n]{1,150}\s+has requested money from you on your kiwi app\.\s*on approving the request,\s*(?:rs\.?|inr|₹)\s*(?<amt>\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s+will be debited from your account\.\s*-\s*kiwi\.?\s*$

examples.body: EXAMPLE STORE has requested money from you on your Kiwi app. On approving the request, Rs.120 will be debited from your account. - Kiwi
EXAMPLE STORE has requested money from you on your Kiwi app. On approving the request, Rs.120 was debited from your account. - Kiwi
